scope: Pure calculation regression and jsdom interaction contracts. No browser visual, geometry, real-device, live-game or gameplay verification.

checks.name: Stats: known baseline from sourced species + formula
Stats: floor effort / 4 before level scaling (252 = 255)
Stats: nature precedes equipment and guardian, HP unaffected by nature
Stats: 25 natures, exactly five balanced
Stats: relation bonus belongs inside level-scaled intimacy
Stats: guardian is excluded from panel and speed
Stats: armor, weapon and accessory add to corresponding dimensions
Stats: reject 100-level equipment on lower-level pet
Stats: reject effort sum > 510 without silently clipping
Stats: reject per-stat effort > 255
Stats: reject speed intimacy, partial relationship budget and non-10 allocations
Stats: empty, decimal and out-of-bounds fields are invalid
Damage: exact default rational calculation and fixed 21 rolls
Damage: 80 through 100 enumerated without custom float inputs
Damage: category selects corresponding entered ability, not a new formula
Damage: single resistance and effectiveness remain finite
Damage: unknown special skill / modifiers / complex types return no range
Damage: zero defense, fractional power and empty HP are rejected
Damage: unresolved minimum-damage edge is explicitly unsupported
Damage: no probability claim in result object
DOM: stats route renders six results and custom selectors
DOM: ability input updates result and shareable query
DOM: shareable ability URL restores exact form after navigation
DOM: changing relationship allocates legal default then allows invalid budget correction
DOM: invalid total effort suppresses numeric outputs
DOM: malformed calc JSON and nested values fall back safely
DOM: ability → damage carries correct category, level and ability
DOM: damage default renders 21 reference rolls
DOM: damage change is deterministic and preserved in URL
DOM: unsupported skill replaces result, has mechanics link
DOM: legacy PP and range routes offer moved links without forms
DOM: comparison keeps radar and uses shared selects
DOM: mechanics first recommendation is stable and changes only on explicit action
DOM: relations retains both selectors with shared component
DOM: no React or jsdom runtime errors
